entries.text: Went to the passport office in Agargaon today. They need the old passport, NID copy and two photos. Fee is 5,750 taka for regular delivery.
Paid the fee through bKash. Biometric appointment is on the 14th at 10am.
Biometric done. They said delivery takes 21 working days. Tracking number is 4000-112233.
পাসপোর্ট অফিস থেকে এসএমএস এসেছে, পুলিশ ভেরিফিকেশন বাকি আছে। থানায় ফোন করতে হবে।
Sylhet trip plan: leave Thursday night by Parabat Express, come back Sunday. Budget around 15,000 taka for two.
Hotel booked — Noorjahan Grand, 2 nights, 4,500 per night. Ratargul আর Jaflong দুইটাই যাবো, Bichanakandi বাদ।
Decided not to rent a car, CNG reserve is cheaper. Rahim bhai's number for CNG: he charges 2,500 for the full day.
Sylhet e brishti hobe mone hocche, raincoat nite hobe. Tea garden er jonno shokal shokal ber hote hobe.
Idea: remind me when I arrive at a place, not at a time. Geofence around saved places.
Decided the minimum radius is 150 metres. Smaller circles miss arrivals because the phone's location is too rough indoors.
Problem: on Xiaomi phones the geofence doesn't fire when battery saver is on. Need to warn the user instead of failing silently.
Still unresolved: what to do when two places overlap. Maybe fire both, maybe ask. Haven't decided.
Went with OpenStreetMap tiles for the pin picker — no API key needed and nothing goes to Google.
আম্মুর প্রেশারের ওষুধ শেষ হয়ে যাচ্ছে। Osartil 50 সকালে একটা, রাতে একটা।
ডাক্তার বলেছে লবণ কম খেতে হবে আর প্রতিদিন আধা ঘণ্টা হাঁটতে হবে।
Next checkup with Dr. Farzana on the 3rd, Labaid Dhanmondi, 6pm. রিপোর্টগুলো সাথে নিতে হবে।
Sugar test result came back 7.2 fasting. Doctor wants to repeat it in three months.
Comparing laptops: ThinkPad E14 at 92,000, Asus Vivobook at 78,000, MacBook Air M2 at 135,000.
Leaning towards the ThinkPad — the keyboard is better and RAM can be upgraded later. The Asus screen looked dim.
Ryans e ThinkPad er dam 2,000 taka kom, kintu warranty 2 bochor. Star Tech e 3 bochor warranty.
Bought the ThinkPad from Star Tech. Paid 91,500 with the card, got a free bag.
Saw the flat in Mohammadpur. 1,250 sq ft, rent 28,000, service charge 4,000. South facing, 5th floor, lift works.
Mirpur DOHS flat: rent 32,000 but includes gas. Landlord wants two months advance.
Problem with the Mohammadpur flat: water pressure is low in the morning, the caretaker admitted it.
বাড়িওয়ালা বলেছে জানুয়ারি থেকে ভাড়া দুই হাজার বাড়বে। নতুন বাসা খোঁজা দরকার।
Ran 5 km in 31 minutes this morning. Knee felt fine.
Weight 78.4 kg. Target is 74 by March.
Trainer said do squats twice a week and stop skipping warm-up. Left knee pain is from tight hamstrings.
Aj gym e jai nai, shorir kharap lagchilo. Kal double korbo.
Supervisor meeting: she wants the literature review cut to 20 pages and more on methodology.
Decided to use mixed methods — survey of 200 students plus 12 interviews.
Deadline for the draft chapter is 30 November. Ethics approval form still not submitted.
Read Creswell chapter 4. Good framework for explaining why qualitative data comes second.
Nadia's wedding is on the 20th of December at Sena Kunja. Need a gift.
Thinking a dinner set from Aarong, around 6,000. Or just cash in an envelope like everyone else.
নাদিয়ার বিয়েতে শাড়ি পরবো নাকি সালোয়ার কামিজ ঠিক করতে পারছি না। নীল শাড়িটা ড্রাই ওয়াশে দিতে হবে।
Roadmap meeting: search is the top priority, export is pushed to Q4. Tanvir disagreed about pushing export.
Decision: we ship offline mode before the redesign. Design team needs three more weeks anyway.
Blocker — the payment provider's sandbox has been down since Monday, can't test checkout.
Asked Sadia to write the release notes. Launch date moved to the 8th.
Car service due at 45,000 km. Currently at 44,200.
Mechanic at Tejgaon said the brake pads need changing, 3,500 taka for both front. Engine oil 4,200.
Garir AC thanda hocche na, gas refill korte hobe. Mechanic bolse 2,500 lagbe.
Electricity bill 3,840 this month, highest this year. AC ran too much.
Internet bill 1,050 paid. Changing from Link3 to Amber IT next month, same price but faster.
রহিমকে পাঁচ হাজার টাকা ধার দিয়েছি, সামনের মাসে ফেরত দেবে বলেছে।
Credit card bill due on the 25th. Minimum is 4,000 but I should pay the full 23,600.
Finished Sapiens. The part about the agricultural revolution being a trap was the best.
হুমায়ূন আহমেদের 'দেয়াল' পড়া শুরু করেছি। ইতিহাস আর গল্প মিশিয়ে লেখা, ভালো লাগছে।
Want to read next: Atomic Habits, The Remains of the Day.
Parent-teacher meeting on Saturday at 11. Class teacher is Ms. Rumana.
Maisha's math result ভালো হয়নি, 62 out of 100. Teacher বলেছে fractions এ সমস্যা।
Found a tutor — Shafiq sir, comes three days a week, 6,000 a month.
School fees for the January term: 18,500. Last date 10 January.
Ammu's beef bhuna: marinate with yogurt and ginger-garlic for two hours. Low heat, at least 90 minutes.
Khichuri te moog dal ar chal shoman shoman, ar ektu ghee dile bhalo hoy.
Tried the pressure cooker for biryani. Rice got mushy — use less water next time, 1:1.25.
Idea: an app to split bills among flatmates, works over SMS so nobody needs to install anything.
Talked to Imran, he thinks bKash integration is the hard part. Their merchant API needs a trade licence.
Parking this until after the thesis. Not enough time.
ঈদের কেনাকাটা: আব্বুর জন্য পাঞ্জাবি, আম্মুর জন্য শাড়ি, মাইশার জন্য জুতা।
Punjabi from Yellow, 3,200. Saree from Aarong 7,800 — over budget but Ammu liked it.
Maisha r juta ekhono kena hoy nai, Bata te size pai nai. Apex e dekhte hobe.
